Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]]. It is the second volume of the ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights]]'' series, and it was first published by [[Berkley Boulevard]] in [[September]] [[1995]]. The novel is set in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], and it follows fourteen-year-old twins [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] during their struggle with the [[Shadow Academy]]. The novel was reprinted in ''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Rise of the Shadow Academy]]'' ([[1996]]) and ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Shadow]]'' ([[2002]]).
